content: {"summary":"To distinguish a write‑refusal caused by snapshot (BGSAVE) failures from one caused by the store being full, the runbook advises checking Redis INFO persistence fields (rdb_last_bgsave_status, rdb_bgsave_in_progress) and INFO memory fields (used_memory, maxmemory, maxmemory_policy). A status of rdb_last_bgsave_status:err together with stop‑writes‑on‑bgsave‑error yes indicates the MISCONF path (snapshot failure). If used_memory is at maxmemory and the policy is noeviction, the OOM path (store full) is the cause.
